alternate_titles: Apostolic Letter issued Motu Proprio on the use of the Roman liturgy prior to the reform of 1970
work.author: Pope Francis
work.description: Francis's apostolic letter given motu proprio on 16 July 2021, effective on publication in L'Osservatore Romano, declaring the liturgical books promulgated by Paul VI and John Paul II the unique expression of the lex orandi of the Roman Rite and restrictively regulating celebration with the 1962 Missal.
work.title: Traditionis custodes
